description: The storage seam is exercised against a managed server DB with multi-instance HA behind a Redis-shared session/rate-limit layer.

requirements.description: The api-core/storage seam must be exercised against a managed server database (e.g., PostgreSQL) in addition to SQLite, enabling multi-instance deployments. Redis-shared session, revocation, and rate-limit state already provides cross-replica coordination. The storage seam abstraction must allow swapping the backing store without changes to business logic. HA deployment must be verified: a session created on instance A is honored on instance B.
requirements.title: Managed-Database Backing and Multi-Instance High Availability

validation.notes: api/internal/storage/seam_test.go: all storage operations are expressed through the seam interface; swap SQLite adapter for a mock adapter → business logic tests pass unchanged

api/handlers/auth/ha_e2e_test.go: register and sign in on instance-1 (sharing Postgres + Redis with instance-2); verify token on instance-2 via JWKS → accepted; revoke session on instance-1 → instance-2 rejects subsequent use
api/internal/storage/storage_bench_test.go: measure login and token-verify latency against Postgres-backed storage; assert p99 < 100 ms under 50 concurrent users

title: Managed-DB Backing + Multi-Instance HA
